CONTACT_MERGED.sentence: This contact was merged into another record. Open that record instead.

CSRF_INVALID.sentence: This page is out of date. Reload it and try again.

EMAIL_INVALID.sentence: That does not look like an email address.

PHONE_INVALID.sentence: That does not look like a phone number.

PORTAL_ACCOUNT_DISABLED.sentence: This account is already disabled. Invite the client again to give access back.

PORTAL_GRANT_INACTIVE.sentence: This client access was revoked or has ended, so nothing new can be shared to it.

PORTAL_ITEM_RETRACTED.sentence: This was already removed from the portal.

PORTAL_KIND_SOURCE_MISMATCH.sentence: That kind of item does not match what was chosen.

PORTAL_LINK_INVALID.sentence: That sign-in link no longer works. Links work once, for 15 minutes; ask for a new one.

PORTAL_LOGIN_POINT_MISSING.sentence: This person has no working email or phone to sign in with. Add one first.

PORTAL_NOT_AVAILABLE.sentence: Client sign-in is not available right now. Ask your agent.

PORTAL_NOT_A_PARTY.sentence: This person is not a buyer, seller or co-party on this deal or listing. Add them first.

PORTAL_NOT_SELLER_SIDE.sentence: Only a seller or co-seller of the deal sees showings, feedback and seller updates. Add them as a seller first.

PORTAL_SOURCE_INVALID.sentence: That item could not be read. Reload and try again.

PORTAL_SOURCE_NOT_IN_GRANT.sentence: That cannot be shared to this client: it is not from their deal or listing, or it is not ready to share.

PORTAL_TEXT_NOT_PLAIN.sentence: That text has characters the portal cannot show; edit it before sharing.

PORTAL_TEXT_TOO_LONG.sentence: That text is over 4,000 characters; shorten it before sharing.

RATE_LIMITED.sentence: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.

signin.acceptedMessage: If that email or phone number is the one your agent set up, and it can get messages from us, we sent a sign-in link. It works once, for 15 minutes. Nothing after a few minutes? Ask your agent.
